# fct_booking_advisor_payments

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_booking_advisor_payments` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Fact table of individual payment records to advisors for bookings in Portal. Includes gross & net amounts, credits applied and issued, payment status, Routable routing info, fee breakdowns (income tax withholding, VAT, Onyx), and all key timestamps (created, approved, scheduled, paid). Each row is a single payment. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | User ID for the Advisor >> Source - Portal DB |
| `approved_at` | When the payment was approved  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `approved_by` | Who approved the Payment  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `booking_fee_paid_income_tax_withholding_usd` | The amount of the Income Tax Witholding (Booking Fee) tied to that Booking Payment to an Advisor  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `booking_fee_paid_onyx_usd` | The amount of the Onyx Payment Processing Fee (Booking Fee) tied to that Booking Payment to an Advisor  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `booking_fee_paid_vat_charge_usd` | The amount of the VAT Charge (Booking Fee) tied to that Booking Payment to an Advisor  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `booking_payment_id` | *Primary* Key. Unique Identifier for the Payment  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `booking_uuid` | Foreign Key to the Bookings table.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_invoice_id` | Foreign Key, unique identifier for a client invoice >> Source - Portal |
| `created_at` | When the record was originally created  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `credit_applied_usd` | The amount of credit that was applied (if any) TO a given payment  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `credit_issued_usd` | The amount of credit that was issued (if any) FROM a given Payment >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `gross_paid_usd` | The total 'Payment Amount' only for payments that have a Payment Date present. Includes the Net Paid Amount + Credit Applied >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `internal_notes` | Any internal notes on the Payment from the HQ team.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `net_paid_usd` | = (Gross Paid) - (Credit Applied), where there is a Payment Date present. Effectively the cash paid. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `notes` | Any notes on the Payment from the HQ team.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `payment_amount_usd` | The total amount to be paid to an Advisor. Includes Net Payment + Credit Applied, even when there is no Payment Date present >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `payment_date` | When the Payment occured  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `payment_purpose` | Whether the payment to the Advisor is for a Booking Commission, or for a Client Invoice they charged, etc.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `payment_type` | What type of payment it was, such as cash, credit, or routable pending.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `payment_url` | URL link for the Payment  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `routable_created_at` | When the Routable Payment was first created  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `routable_paid_at` | When the Routable Payment was paid  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `routable_country_code` | 2 letter country code of the Routable payment  >>  SOURCE - Routable via Portal |
| `routable_currency_code` | 3 letter currency code of the Routable payment  >>  SOURCE - Routable via Portal |
| `routable_payment_id` | Foreign Key. Identifies the Routable Payment  >>  SOURCE - Routable via Portal |
| `routable_payment_scheduled_at` | When the Routable Payment was originally scheduled for  >>  SOURCE - Routable via Portal |
| `routable_payment_status` | Status of the Routable Payment  >>  SOURCE - Routable via Portal |
| `routable_user_payout_method_id` | Foreign key to the 'User Payout Method ID' in Routable >> SOURCE - Routable via Portal |
